name: web-early-access-login-card-on-big-screen-thumbnail
title: Early-access sign-up page on a wall screen: serif headline, mountain photo and white login card, small
whatItIs: A large wall screen in a dark gallery room displays a white page with a serif 'Get Early Access', a desert-mountain photo along the bottom and a white login card with Google button, email, role and a black Request Access button.
whatItMeans: Calm and premium; earthy mountains and serif type feel like an exclusive launch.
techniques: Show the page on a large screen in a dark space.
Use a mountain strip as a footer image.
Float the form card over the photo edge.
Use serif for the heading and a black button.

vocabulary.definition: A page collecting sign-ups before launch.
A white card with a form.
A mockup showing a display in a space.
A photo band along the page bottom.
